References of a result or of the package

Source: R/references.R
vlm_cite.Rd

vlm_cite() gives the references of the methods behind a result of the package, or every reference of the package, as text or BibTeX. citation("VetResearchLMM") cites the package and the book.

Usage

vlm_cite(x = NULL, style = c("text", "bibtex"))

# Default S3 method
vlm_cite(x = NULL, style = c("text", "bibtex"))

Arguments

x

a result of a function of the package, or NULL (default) for every reference.

style

"text" (default) or "bibtex".

Value

An object of class bibentry (printed in the chosen style).

See also

Other VetResearchLMM utilities: autoplot.vlm_result(), vlm_app(), vlm_interpret(), vlm_notation(), vlm_reference(), vlm_save(), vlm_theme()

Author

Muhammad Yaseen (myaseen208@gmail.com)

Examples

vlm_cite(
    x     = NULL
  , style = "text"
  )
